title: Projection-normalized coefficient transport of the published completed pullback tower
statement: Fix ell,E,X,Y,g with ell invertible on both schemes, and a normalized finite strict-tower comparison C [lem-a1-finite-pullback-strict-tower-comparison]. Use the projection-normalized completed and finite coefficient isomorphisms and the interface of [def-pod-integral-completed-comparison-data]. Put H=derived_Y ⋙ C.B.functor ⋙ Rlim_X as in [lem-a1-integral-roos-finite-tower-realization]. There are natural module isomorphisms e_n:finiteIntegral_n→finiteCompleted_n, fixed on every pulled quotient-unit generator, and a natural isomorphism b from the published strict completed pullback followed by exact coefficient restriction to H, on the entire derived category. For every good transported representative P whose localization is intrinsically complete, let beta be the existing unit-normalized actual-to-strict tower comparison followed by b. Then beta followed by H's nth computation projection and Q(e_n) is exactly completedProjection followed by finiteComputation. For every complete K and integer r, K[r] is complete, and beta intertwines the retained shifts of the actual completed pullback and H, for every intrinsic-completeness proof. This statement constructs no isomorphism involving the integral Roos pullback.

proof.text: Obtain the normalized ordinary finite coefficient isomorphisms e from finiteIntegral_coefficientComparison.

Construct a global strict-to-actual comparison explicitly: conjugate stratumReductionIso by pullbackDatumOrdinaryTransport and pullbackDatumTowerTransport, apply completedTowerRlim, and compose with actualCompletion_quotient inverse. reductionAugmentationTransport and constantRlimUnit_eq prove its unit normalization. This is the construction of pbcActualCompletedPullback_tower before restriction to complete inputs.

Apply strictIntegral_coefficientTowerTransport to e and this global comparison a, obtaining b, its strict projection equation, and the CommShift structure for coefficient restriction of a inverse followed by b.

Uniqueness in pbcActualCompletedPullback_tower identifies the restriction of a to intrinsically complete inputs with towerIso. Consequently completedToFiniteTower is a component of the global isomorphism c obtained by whiskering a inverse and composing b.

Precompose the strict projection equation by coefficient restriction of towerIso inverse. Functor.map_comp and associativity identify the right side with completedProjection followed by finiteComputation. This proves the representative clause without modifying the chosen finite or completed projection.

Transport completeness back to the actual coefficient presentation, apply actualComplete_shift, and transport forward. Rewrite completedToFiniteTower as c.app and apply NatTrans.shift_app_comm to c.hom; the equation has the required orientation for all intrinsic-completeness proofs.

theorem completedIntegral_finiteTowerTransport
    (hX : ∀ x : X, IsUnit (l : X.presheaf.stalk x))
    (hY : ∀ y : Y, IsUnit (l : Y.presheaf.stalk y))
    (C : FinitePullbackStrictTower.Comparison.{u, u} l E g) :
    ∃ (e : ∀ n : ℕ, finiteIntegral l E g n ≅ finiteCompleted l E g n)
      (b : transportedStrict l E g ≅ finiteTowerLimit l E g C),
      (∀ n : ℕ, FiniteNormalization l E g n (e n)) ∧
      (∀ (P : CochainComplex
          (pbcModules Y (pbcAdicCompletion Y (pbcIntegralDatum l E))) ℤ)
        (hP : integralOperationsGoodComplex.{u, u} l E Y ((complexes l E Y).obj P))
        (hK : PbcIsIntrinsicallyComplete Y (pbcIntegralDatum l E) (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P))
        (n : ℕ),
        (completedToFiniteTower l E g C b (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) hK).hom ≫
            finiteTowerLimitProjection l E g C P n ≫
            DerivedCategory.Q.map ((finiteComplexComparison l E g n (e n)).app P) =
          completedProjection l E g (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) hK n ≫
            finiteComputation l E g P n) ∧
      ∀ (K : PbcCompletedDerived Y (pbcIntegralDatum l E)) (hK : Complete l E K) (r : ℤ),
        ∃ hKr : Complete l E (K⟦r⟧),
          ∀ (hI : PbcIsIntrinsicallyComplete Y (pbcIntegralDatum l E) K)
            (hIr : PbcIsIntrinsicallyComplete Y (pbcIntegralDatum l E) (K⟦r⟧)),
          (completedToFiniteTower l E g C b (K⟦r⟧) hIr).hom ≫
              ((finiteTowerLimit l E g C).commShiftIso r).hom.app K =
            ((completed l E g).commShiftIso r).hom.app K ≫
              ((completedToFiniteTower l E g C b K hI).hom)⟦r⟧'
